raw.title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
raw.description:
InMobi Advertising is a global technology leader helping marketers win the moments that matter. Our advertising platform reaches over 2 billion people across 150+ countries and turns real-time context into business outcomes, delivering results grounded in privacy-first principles. Trusted by 30,000+ brands and leading publishers, InMobi is where intelligence, creativity, and accountability converge. By combining lock screens, apps, TVs, and the open web with AI and machine learning, we deliver receptive attention, precise personalization, and measurable impact.

Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI transforms every screen into a gateway for instant, personal, and joyful discovery.  Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi's global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company's Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you'll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com

Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Salary Range (Germany):

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy.

Note: Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. 

Benefits:

As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

Data Privacy Notice (GDPR)

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

Your data will be retained for the duration of the recruitment process and, where applicable, for a period thereafter in accordance with statutory retention obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties outside of the recruitment process without your explicit consent.

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise your rights or for any data privacy enquiries, please contact: -----

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understood this data privacy notice and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

As a Senior Financial Analyst (all genders) focused on Commercial Finance & Revenue at Hubject, you'll be the key link between Finance and our Commercial teams and collaborate closely with the CFO and commercial leadership to shape how we understand, forecast, and grow revenue. You'll bring energy and ownership to a role that mixes rigorous analysis with hands-on business partnering. Also, you'll create transparency around our revenue drivers, support critical business decisions, and actively shape the way we report and forecast revenue.


Why Hubject

We develop ideas and deliver solutions for the eMobility market
We are working on the most important growth topics
We are an international team of very motivated eMobility enthusiasts

AND

We have over 30 benefits different categories:

  • Food & drinks (food subsidy on the Euref-Campus restaurants)

  • Mobility (BVG subsidy)

  • Health & sports (Urban sports membership M)

  • Equipment (Laptop etc)

  • Learning and development (yearly training budget and Udemy learning platform access)

  • Hubject Lifestyle (Voiio membership)

  • Family-friendly environment (flex working time)


Your Tasks

  • Own revenue analyses, forecasts and ongoing reporting to management.  
  • Act as a trusted business partner to Sales, Product and Leadership on commercial decisions.  
  • Develop pricing, margin and profitability analyses with actionable recommendations.  
  • Build business cases and evaluate new business models, deals and partnerships.  
  • Analyze revenue drivers, customer segments and product profitability.  
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and mid-term planning on the revenue side.  
  • Collaborate closely with Accounting on revenue recognition topics.  
  • Drive continuous improvement of KPIs, reporting structures and forecast models.  
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships across Finance, Commercial and Leadership, acting as a go-to partner for revenue-related questions.


Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Controlling, or a related field.  
  • Several years of experience in Commercial Finance, Revenue Controlling, or FP&A.  
  • Solid understanding of revenue models, pricing, and deal structures.  
  • Proven experience business partnering with commercial functions and senior stakeholders, with the confidence to challenge and influence decision-making.  
  • Strong Excel and BI skills (e.g., Power BI, Tableau); ERP experience is a plus.  
  • Proactive, high-energy, and entrepreneurial mindset with a track record of taking ownership, driving topics independently, and thriving in a fast-paced environment.  


Language

  • Excellent communication skills and business fluency in English (company language).


Start date

  • As soon as possible


Location

Onsite in Berlin

Hybrid set-up:

  • 1-2 days per week at the office,  rest remote from the comfort of your home :)

  • EUREF Campus in Schöneberg in Berlin - Europe's hotspot for green technology and eMobility


(Remote within Germany possible)

description: Warum diese Rolle? Verwaltungen stecken im Investitionsstau. Du bist unser Turbo. Du führst dein Team gemeinsam mit der Produktmanagerin als Doppelspitze. Du arbeitest eng mit den anderen Engineering Managern, dem Senior Software Architekten und dem Head of Development zusammen. Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p>Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende.&nbsp;Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus<br>Käufe wurden.&nbsp;Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in&nbsp;mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen<br>Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.<br><br>VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein&nbsp;schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die&nbsp;Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter&nbsp;Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Zur Verve Retail Media gehört seit kurzem der Couponing- und&nbsp;Cashback-Spezialist acardo.<br><br><strong>Die Rolle in einem Satz</strong><br>Du trägst eine Hunter-Mentalität in dir und gewinnst neue Umsätze bei FMCG-Marken, indem du&nbsp;integrierte Shopper Activation Kampagnen verkaufst: d.h. coupon-getriebene Conversion und messbarer&nbsp;Sales Lift, idealerweise erweitert um Screen-Präsenz im Markt.</p> <p><strong>Was du verkaufst</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ein kombiniertes Produkt aus digitaler Sichtbarkeit im Markt Screens an Eingang, Fläche, Kasse), Aktivierung am Point of Sale (über Coupons) und Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten (anstatt isolierter Werbeflächen oder losgelöster Coupons)</li> <li>Kampagnen, die drei Logiken beim Kunden verbinden: Markenreichweite, Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz</li> <li>360Grad-Aktivierung, die über den Markt hinausgeht: (Re)Targeting im CTV und weiteren Offsite-Kanälen als Verlängerung der In-Store-Kampagne</li> <li>Konkrete Beweispunkte aus Pilotprojekten: z.B. 9% Uplift auf Store-Ebene, 20% in ausgewählten Kategorien</li> </ul> <p><strong>An wen du verkaufst<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Direkt an FMCG-Marken</li> <li>Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus Brand und Media (-Planung und -Einkauf) und verwalten <span class="s4">drei Budgettöpfe mit unterschiedlichen Zielen, Freigabelogiken und Erfolgsmetriken</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></p> <ul> <li>Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen</li> <li>Neukunden und Stakeholder (horizontal und vertikal) gewinnen und Kunden zu wiederkehrenden Partnern entwickeln</li> <li>Den kompletten Sales-Zyklus verantworten: Erstansprache, Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss. Mit Abschluss erfolgt die Übergabe ans AdOps Team</li> <li>Kundenziele in Media- und Aktivierungskonzepte übersetzen: Touchpoints, Reichweiten, Zielgruppen, Mechaniken Cashback, Gratis-Testen, Kategorie-Trigger), Messansatz</li> <li>Sales-Lift-Daten und Pilotergebnisse als Beweispunkte im Pitch einsetzen, um aus ersten Testbudgets hohe wiederkehrende Volumina zu machen</li> <li>VRM gegenüber konkurrierenden Retail-Media-Formaten klar differenzieren</li> <li>Feedback aus dem Markt in Produkt, Pitchmaterial und Go-to-Market zurückspielen</li> </ul> <p><strong>So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du bist ein Individual Contributor ohne Personalverantwortung</li> <li>Du berichtest direkt an die CSO</li> <li>Du verkaufst eigenständig, aber nicht allein: Media Planning entwickelt das Kampagnen-Setup, Ad Operations steuert die Auslieferung, Data Science liefert den Wirkungsnachweis</li> <li>Dein Fokus ist kommerziell: Pipeline, Abschluss, Kundentiefe, Wiederbuchung</li> </ul> <p><strong>Warum diese Rolle</strong></p> <p>Du liebst es, Dinge von Grund auf mit aufzubauen. title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
description: Über tonies: tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. Du als Teil von tonies: Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben. Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen: IT-Strategie & Architektur Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit. Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce). Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX. IT-Governance & Sicherheit Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal). Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.). Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans. Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende. Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen. Was wir uns von dir wünschen: Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich). Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards. Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“. Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365). Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen. Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus). Warum tonies? Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies ® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt. Wir freuen uns auf deine digitale Bewerbung! Ketsia Dinzala People & Culture Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Manager - E-commerce (all genders)
description: About tonies: tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries. Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination. You as part of tonies: Are you passionate about bringing interactive edutainment to kids across the world? We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Ecommerce to lead the evolution of our global digital commerce platforms. The Mission Your mission is to own and evolve the global digital commerce platforms to enable scalable, performant, and business-aligned commerce experiences. You will act as the strategic anchor for the shopping experience, ensuring our platform investments align with global business priorities while balancing operational efficiency with scalability. Success is measured by delivering commercial growth, improving conversion rates, and optimizing platform efficiency, experimentation velocity, and stakeholder satisfaction. Your tasks and responsibilities will include: Strategic Direction & Platform Ownership Lead the Vision: Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for our global e-commerce platforms, ensuring a unified shopping experience across all markets. Architecture Governance: Partner closely with Engineering to govern architecture decisions during and post-migration, ensuring a robust foundation for 2026+. Vendor Management: Own strategic relationships and manage software vendors and tools used across the platform (e.g., payment processing, CMS) to maximize value and performance. Business Alignment: Align platform investments with global and local business priorities, driving cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams. Execution & Operational Excellence Drive Execution: Own the execution of key initiatives within a cross-functional team, continuously prioritizing opportunities to maintain a competitive roadmap. Global Consistency: Ensure 100% parity of core shopping flows (product pages, checkout) across major regions and drive cross-market consistency. Continuous Discovery: Drive continuous discovery for future evolutions, validating new concepts with a "customer-centric" approach. Mentorship: Act as a senior mentor to Product Managers (e.g., Checkout, Landing & Merch), fostering a culture of product excellence, innovation, and collaboration What we are looking for: Visionary & Experienced: You have at least 7+ years of product management experience in e-commerce, with a track record of leading complex platform strategies. Technical Fluency: You are fluent in e-commerce and marketing technology (Shopify, Commercetools, etc.) and can confidently own the technology stack. Strategic & Operational: You can balance rapid growth across markets with improving the existing 'glocal' experience. Data-Driven: You love data and use it to evangelize quality insights, defining success metrics that drive fast build-and-learn cycles. Leadership: You are a clear communicator with high empathy. Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world. PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can. 

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing. 

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Get in touch with us

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Technology and Cyber team are looking for an experienced&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Senior&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">ServiceNow Engineer to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><strong>Please note, although this role is remote you do need to be based and have right to work within the UK</strong></span></span></p> <p>Baringa has grown so fast, and it continues to grow rapidly. Those new joiners keep on coming! We are a global function supporting the firm as it enters new markets. We are re-architecting and evolving our cloud-based business systems and infrastructure. We are on a mission to develop great technology products, deliver great services, and protect the trust our people and clients place in us. We have installed a new operating system for ourselves, and rebooted what was a corporate IT department into a corporate technology company, transforming the way we work.</p> <p>Now we are building for the next era of work. Some of it will sit beneath the surface: data products, workflow platforms, integrations, automations, cyber security, governance, and the architecture that makes all of it safe, scalable, resilient, and useful.</p> <p>So much to build on, so much to progress. So much to deliver. So much to play for!</p> <p>Do you know what though? We are going to do it. All of it and more. We have the support to drive change. We have the belief. We are going to do great things. Come and join us!</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>As a Senior ServiceNow Engineer within the Operational Excellence team, you will play a key role in Baringa’s digital transformation. The role offers broad exposure, significant responsibility, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on how Technology &amp; Cyber operates. We operate on a configuration first, customisation last development model.</p> <ul> <li>System design, configuration, testing and support.</li> <li>Implementing ServiceNow standards as best practices.</li> <li>Working with Workflow Studio flows and integrations.</li> <li>Supporting our current stack as BAU – CSM, ITSM, FCM, WSD and more.</li> <li>Ability to define, document and implement technical requirements.</li> <li>Experience in integrations &amp; Service Graph Connections.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to automate business processes and end user experience in general.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>Certified System Administrator required.</li> <li>Certified Application Developer preferred.</li> <li>ITIL foundation certification is preferred.</li> <li>Experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementations and support.</li> <li>Additionally, experience in CSM and HRSD a huge plus.</li> <li>Well organised and proactive individual who is calm under pressure with the ability to problem solve.</li> <li>Experienced in working in an Agile environment with the ability to prioritise appropriately.</li> <li>Excellent soft skills with the ability to communicate to all levels within the business.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres - they are where value is won or lost.&nbsp;</span></span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"></span></p> <p>The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.</p> <p>We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.</p> <p>We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.</p> <p>We work in small, senior teams – so you own real client relationships and real commercial outcomes from day one. We're looking for Senior Managers who want to be the name clients ask for and the market knows. This is a role for people who want to win and deliver work while they build a practice: originating opportunities, leading complex engagements, and growing the reputations – theirs and ours – that open the next door.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"></span></span></p> <p></p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise&nbsp;</span></span></h2> <p></p> <p>Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital Resilience:</strong> helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.</li> <li><strong>Digital Trust: </strong>helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.</p> <p>We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"></span></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"></span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="34" checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd like to hear from you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>A track record of winning work:</strong> Demonstrable experience originating and closing cyber, resilience or digital risk work – building pipeline, shaping bids and owning a personal sales contribution.</li> <li><strong>Engagement leadership:</strong> The credibility to lead complex, multi-workstream engagements as a senior expert, balancing deep cyber knowledge with commercial and stakeholder judgement.</li> <li><strong>People leadership: </strong>Experience leading and developing mixed delivery teams, and coaching others to perform.</li> <li><strong>Senior client relationships: </strong>A network you can activate, and the ability to build trusted relationships at CISO and board level.</li> <li><strong>Digital risk and cyber depth:</strong> A strong track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, gained in consulting or in-house, and a clear view on where the market is heading – DORA, the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill, CAF, AI and cloud risk.</li> <li><strong>Technology and AI literacy:</strong> Fluency in, or real curiosity about, using AI to deliver and advising clients on securing and governing it.</li> <li><strong>Depth in one or more of our domains:</strong> Meaningful experience in at least one area we operate in – particularly OT/ICS security, CAF, AI security and governance, post-quantum and cryptographic agility, or operational resilience.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey Voice for Meetings builds DeepL's real time AI voice technology for professional collaboration. The team works on in call transcription, translation, and voice intelligence, delivered live across the meeting platforms people already use every day. The engineering problems are genuinely hard. Everything happens in real time, latency is measured in milliseconds, and quality is immediately visible to the person on the call. The team sits close to our applied science colleagues, so engineering and research work side by side rather than at arm's length. This is also one of the most consequential products at DeepL right now. Voice for Meetings sits on the critical path for the next phase of the company's growth, which means the work is visible, the decisions matter, and the team has real influence over where the product goes. You will lead a small, senior team and work day to day alongside a Principal Product Manager and the team's most senior technical lead. Your responsibilities As Senior Engineering Manager for Voice for Meetings, you will lead the engineering team building DeepL's real time AI voice products. This is a hands on leadership role. You will be accountable for what the team builds and how well it works, and you will be close enough to the code to have a real opinion about it. Lead, develop, and grow a small team of senior engineers, owning hiring, performance, and career development. Drive end to end delivery of real time voice features from architecture through to production, holding a high bar for quality and pace at the same time. Own the technical direction for your team's systems. Stay close enough to the detail to challenge senior engineers credibly and to get into the code yourself when it helps. Work in a tight loop with your Principal Product Manager and senior technical lead, shaping what gets built rather than receiving a finished plan. Operate confidently at the boundary with applied science. Understand how inference, preprocessing, and training data drift affect the product, and translate between model realities and delivery commitments. Make and communicate clear technical trade offs under real constraints, including latency budgets, model quality, and timelines. Spot risks and gaps beyond your own remit and fix them properly, leaving the teams around you better off rather than just unblocking yourself. Build a high agency, low bureaucracy culture where engineers are trusted to make decisions and take genuine ownership of outcomes. Qualities we look for We care much more about how you think and what you have built than whether your background matches ours exactly. You have managed engineers directly and owned a team's delivery, performance, and development. You have hired people, grown them, and handled the difficult conversations as well as the good ones. You are a builder. You are comfortable in the trenches, you have real technical skills, and you have no interest in managing from a distance. If your hands on skills are a little rusty, that is fine, as long as you want to stay close to the work. You have led teams building product that users touch. Real time systems, streaming, distributed systems at scale, or similar. What matters is that technical depth was the substance of the work rather than a detail in the background. You have enough credibility to earn the confidence of senior engineers. You can reason about architecture, spot the failure modes, and add judgment to a technical decision rather than only facilitating it. You have a pragmatic working understanding of how ML systems behave in production. Inference, preprocessing, data drift, and what breaks when a model meets real users. You do not need to be an ML specialist. You think independently and act without waiting to be asked, and you draw those same instincts out of the people around you. You have strong product and commercial instinct. You frame engineering trade offs in terms of user and business outcomes. You are comfortable when the direction is still forming and priorities compete. Nice to have Experience with voice, speech, or audio technology, including ASR, TTS, or real time audio pipelines. A strong plus rather than a requirement, and we are genuinely open to engineering leaders from other technically demanding domains. You have grown into a senior remit inside one organisation rather than moving on each time the title was available. Experience building in a startup or a small product organisation, including something ambitious that did not work out. Experience integrating with third party platform APIs where you do not control the other side. Experience leading a team through a significant architectural change or technical pivot. What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.   • You have strong product and commercial instinct. You frame engineering trade offs in terms of user and business outcomes.

  • You are comfortable when the direction is still forming and priorities compete.

  • You have grown into a senior remit inside one organisation rather than moving on each time the title was available.

  • Experience building in a startup or a small product organisation, including something ambitious that did not work out.

  • Experience integrating with third party platform APIs where you do not control the other side.

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural change or technical pivot.

This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Director, International Revenue Growth

CreatorIQ is seeking a Director or Senior Director, International Revenue Growth to build and own the marketing, pipeline, and revenue growth function across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, this leader will be responsible for generating demand across priority international markets while serving as a strategic revenue partner to regional sales. They will work closely with enterprise sales leaders and sellers to shape go-to-market strategy for a defined set of critical accounts, create account-specific growth plans, and accelerate high-value opportunities.

The role will initially launch with support from a U.S.-based marketing team and a network of contractors. Over time, this leader will define the regional organization, hire people on the ground, and build a scalable international growth function.

This role may be based in either the UK or the Netherlands. It requires travel to London at least monthly, as well as regular travel to customer meetings, team gatherings, and field events across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, hands-on execution, strong enterprise sales partnership, and deep knowledge of the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets. They will help CreatorIQ support its initial $8M international revenue goal while building the pipeline, operating model, and team required for the next stage of growth.

The final title, Director or Senior Director, will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, leadership background, scope, and demonstrated ability to build and scale an international revenue growth function.

This is a remote role based in the UK, with travel to London approximately 1–2 times per month. The role also requires regular travel across Europe for events and occasional travel to the Asia-Pacific region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Build and own CreatorIQ’s international revenue growth engine across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, establishing the regional strategy, priorities, operating rhythm, resource plan, and measurement framework across key markets.

  • Generate net-new demand through integrated regional growth programs spanning account-based marketing, field marketing, executive engagement, events, partner activation, seller enablement, localized campaigns, and priority-account plays.

  • Serve as the strategic revenue partner to the RVP of International Sales, regional sales leaders, and enterprise sellers, aligning on market priorities, account coverage, pipeline goals, opportunity strategy, and actions required to accelerate growth.

  • Own the growth strategy for a defined set of critical enterprise accounts, partnering with sellers to identify buying-group priorities, shape account plans, coordinate targeted marketing support, and create account-specific engagement programs.

  • Help accelerate high-value opportunities by activating executive and customer engagement, developing relevant regional messaging and proof points, supporting buying committees, and removing marketing-related barriers throughout the sales cycle.

  • Define CreatorIQ’s strongest product-market fit and right to win by country, industry, vertical, customer segment, and account type, using customer insight, seller feedback, market data, competitive intelligence, and performance signals to focus investment.

  • Bring a nuanced understanding of European and Asia-Pacific markets into go-to-market decisions, adapting strategy, messaging, events, channels, and seller support to reflect differences in buying behavior, market maturity, business culture, procurement processes, and local conditions.

  • Establish a clear operating cadence with sales around target-account selection, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, campaign performance, forecast risk, and next-best actions for priority accounts.

  • Launch the function with support from U.S.-based marketing partners and specialized contractors, creating clear ownership, processes, standards, and accountability across a distributed team.

  • Build the long-term regional organization by defining the talent plan, hiring people in priority markets, and developing a high-performing on-the-ground international revenue growth team.

  • Deliver measurable revenue impact by supporting the initial $8M international revenue goal and building future pipeline; define KPIs, review performance, share insights, and reallocate resources toward the highest-return opportunities.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS growth, demand generation, revenue marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, or go-to-market leadership, with a demonstrated record of creating pipeline and revenue impact across international markets.

  • Significant experience partnering directly with enterprise sales leaders and sellers in complex B2B sales environments, with a strong understanding of long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, account planning, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity progression.

  • A demonstrated ability to both generate net-new demand and influence the acceleration of complex enterprise opportunities, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes.

  • Experience working on a named-account or strategic-account basis, including account selection, buying-committee strategy, executive engagement, opportunity reviews, account-specific campaigns, and coordinated pursuit plans.

  • Deep familiarity with the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets, with the ability to adapt go-to-market strategy by country and region rather than apply a single global playbook.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional growth function, including evaluating product-market fit, prioritizing countries and customer segments, and translating market strategy into executable programs.

  • Hands-on expertise across integrated growth channels, including ABM, field and event marketing, partner programs, seller enablement, executive programs, localized campaigns, and digital demand generation.

  • Experience building a new function from the ground up, including leading through contractors and shared resources initially, then hiring, developing, and scaling a regional team.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the credibility to advise, challenge, and support sales leadership as a true revenue partner rather than simply respond to campaign requests.

  • An analytical, highly collaborative, and culturally aware leadership style, with excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Comfort operating across time zones, ambiguity, distributed teams, frequent travel, and a fast-moving global environment.

  • Based in the UK or the Netherlands, with the ability to travel to London at least monthly and regularly attend customer meetings, partner engagements, team gatherings, and field events across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About the Team

Our Finance team is the backbone of Lokalise's financial operations—ensuring accuracy, compliance, and control as we scale. Reporting to the Financial Controller and working closely with FP&A, you will step into a broad, hands-on role.

You will own month-end close and balance sheet integrity across our global entities while acting as the primary internal liaison for our external accounting, payroll, and EOR providers. Additionally, you will champion our finance automation program, transitioning the team from manual workflows to highly scalable, controlled processes.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own the month-end close across multiple entities, managing journals, accruals, reconciliations, and reporting strictly to the group timetable.
  • Own balance sheet integrity, with a specific focus on payroll and employment costs.
  • Act as the internal client for outsourced accounting, payroll, and EOR platforms. Review output, hold them to SLAs, and review/approve payroll across our US, UK, Spanish, Latvian, and EOR entities to meet statutory deadlines.
  • Prepare and post payroll/employment cost journals into the ERP, ensuring data integrity between our HRIS and payroll providers.
  • Provide detailed analysis and actionable commentary on Operating Expenses and other critical areas of the P&L.
  • Lead the charge on documenting and improving workflows. You will transition manual reviews into risk-based, threshold-driven controls.
  • Support annual audits and statutory reporting alongside our auditors and outsourced providers.

 

What You Must Have

  • 5+ years in a hands-on accounting role within a SaaS or tech company, including payroll accounting processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations), month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations across multiple entities.
  • Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or equivalent), or qualified by extensive relevant experience.
  • Experience acting as the internal client for external accounting, payroll, or EOR providers — reviewing their output and holding them accountable for accuracy and compliance. A strong accounting foundation is important, alongside experience working with one or more of these provider models.
  • Solid working knowledge of multi-country payroll and payroll-to-GL processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations).
  • Accounting ERP experience and highly advanced Excel/Google Sheet skills.
  • Comfort leveraging AI and automation tools in your day-to-day work, proactively exploring how AI-driven workflows can reduce manual effort and improve controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Wider EU payroll exposure.
  • Experience with EOR providers (Oyster, Deel, Remote, Papaya).
  • Experience migrating to or implementing a cloud ERP.
  • Experience with Rillet, Ramp, Stripe or Xero.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

 

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

We’re scaling fast, doing things differently, and we’re looking for a HR Partner. Someone that thrives using creativity and deep ER & people expertise to guide people managers in an environment that has variety and the occasional bit of chaos that comes with startup life.

This is a hands-on, people-first role where you’ll partner closely with our rapidly growing Patient Experience function, supporting managers and teams through a period of significant growth and transformation. You’ll play a key role in shaping the employee experience, building management capability, and helping teams perform at their best in a fast-paced operational environment.

This role is not for a HR generalist. It is for a true subject matter expert, that specialises in employee relations, performance, coaching managers through complex situations and driving people initiatives. You’ll be right at the heart of the action and a trusted partner to the business, spending time at both our London (Kings Cross) and Winnersh (Reading) offices every week.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner closely with Team Leads and Managers across the Patient Experience team to provide day-to-day HR support and guidance on all matters employee relations, performance management & development and people coaching.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on people matters including performance management, wellbeing, absence, conduct and employee relations

  • Support the full employee lifecycle from induction and probation through to progression and offboarding

  • Coach and support managers to lead confidently, effectively and in line with company culture and values

  • Work closely with recruitment and onboarding teams to ensure a smooth and positive experience for all new starters

  • Support and lead on employee relations matters including investigations, performance concerns, welfare discussions and probation reviews

  • Collaborate with the Head of People & Talent on key people initiatives, process improvements and wider People projects

  • Help embed and improve key people processes such as engagement surveys, performance check-ins, recognition initiatives and manager development

  • Use data, trends and employee feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and proactively solve problems

  • Support policy implementation and provide practical HR guidance in line with UK employment law and best practice

  • Build strong relationships across operational teams and become a trusted and visible People partner within the business

  • Support change, growth and organisational development as the business continues to scale rapidly

What do you need?

  • Strong HRBP experience within a fast-paced, high-growth or operational environment where you have been supporting new & seasoned managers with complex people management, performance and development challenges.

  • Experience supporting large frontline or customer-focused teams is highly desirable

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and adapting quickly as priorities evolve

  • Confidence handling employee relations matters with a calm, fair and pragmatic approach

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence and support managers at different levels

  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands

  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in

  • Self-sufficient and comfortable working remotely whilst collaborating closely with UK-based teams

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law is beneficial but not essential

  • Experience using HR systems such as HiBob is advantageous but not required

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Senior Counsel, Commercial - EU / UK
description: Marqeta is seeking a Senior Counsel, Commercial who will be an integral member of Marqeta’s Commercial Legal Team and strategic partner to the Revenue, Product and Finance Teams in the UK / EU Region. As Senior Commercial Counsel, you will provide legal and business advice relating to commercial contracts entered into by Marqeta or Marqeta’s EU/UK subsidiaries, including agreements with customers, banks and network partners, and vendors in the EU and UK, and will help improve Marqeta’s contracting processes and procedures in the region. You will have a broad range of responsibilities and work in close partnership with cross-functional and geographically diverse teams supporting the development and delivery of Marqeta’s payment products and services. You will report to the Director, Assistant General Counsel. This role will be based out of our London office in Holborn two days a week. Please speak to the recruiter for further details. We'd love for you to join us! The Impact You’ll Have Work with sales, partnership, and procurement teams to support the sale and development of Marqeta’s products and services with a focus on Marqeta’s customers and partners in Europe. Specifically, you will negotiate strategic, complex and cross-border agreements with Marqeta’s customers and partners within Europe. Assist with resolving complex issues in strategic customer, bank and network partner, and vendor agreements in Europe. Support Marqeta’s expansion by partnering with cross-functional teams in sales, product, compliance, bank partnerships, and finance to help sell Marqeta’s products and services in Europe. Work collaboratively across the Legal, Regulatory and Compliance team on cross-functional priorities and initiatives. Collaborate on the development of agreement templates and playbooks for the Commercial Legal Team to drive scale, and cross-functional efficiencies, and offer creative solutions where appropriate. Provide practical legal advice to the business and develop strong working relationships across the Company with cross-functional peers and other business stakeholders. Who You Are 4-7 years of experience practicing either in-house or at a reputable law firm, with at least 2 years working in or advising companies in the payments, fintech or financial services space An eagerness to learn, a can-do attitude, and an interest (and ideally some experience working) in the payments industry A solutions-oriented attorney who doesn’t rabbit-hole on theoretical risk but instead focuses on practical risk-based solutions to legal issues Experience drafting and negotiating contracts for payments companies, fintech companies or financial institutions An understanding of laws and regulations pertaining to financial services and technology (including Payment Services Directives; Anti-Money Laundering Directives; GDPR; Interchange Fee Regulations and EBA Guidelines) A keen sense of ownership, and adaptability to a fast-changing environment Sound judgment and ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively Willingness and ability to support colleagues and initiatives across multiple time zones Recruiter for this role Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!) Typical Process Application Submission Recruiter video call Hiring manager video call Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 4, 45 min calls Offer! We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all. Marqeta’s Values – Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do. – Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish. – Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes. – Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team. – Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right. description: What is Jedox? Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.
