Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions. In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success. We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together. Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory. Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth. Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features. Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning. Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders. Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number. Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market. Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners. Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities. Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success. Your Profile Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function. Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions. Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals. Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts. A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together. Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win. A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from. Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation. Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle. Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ping Identity:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.&nbsp;</p> <p>While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pingidentity.com/en/company/championing-every-identity.html">We champion every identity.</a> One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.&nbsp;</p> <p>We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.&nbsp;</p></div><h3>Senior UX Design Developer</h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote (UK-based)&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Team:</strong> UX Design&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Hybrid role blending user experience design and frontend prototyping</strong></p> <p>At Ping Identity, we believe the best user experiences are designed through exploration, iteration, and hands-on prototyping. We’re looking for a Senior UX Design Developer who thrives at the intersection of design and code—someone equally comfortable designing experiences and bringing them to life in code.</p> <p>You’ll use code as a design tool—not simply as an implementation medium—to explore ideas, validate interactions, and shape product direction. As design and implementation continue to converge through modern frontend tooling and AI-native workflows, we’re looking for someone excited to help define what that future looks like at Ping Identity.</p> <p>As part of our UX team, you’ll help shape the experiences customers use to discover, configure, manage, and get the most out of Ping Identity’s products. Working closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and engineers, you’ll transform ideas into interactive prototypes that validate concepts, influence product direction, and help ensure exceptional implementation quality across our products and supporting experiences.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prototype interactive user experiences in code to explore, communicate, and validate ideas.</li> <li>Rapidly prototype workflows, interactions, and usability concepts before implementation.</li> <li>Design user experiences for complex enterprise SaaS applications and supporting customer experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate with product managers, UX researchers, designers, and engineers to define requirements and shape product direction.</li> implementations and helping ensure the final product reflects the original design intent.</li> <li>Balance user needs, accessibility requirements, technical constraints, and business goals.</li> <li>Use modern design tools to explore concepts, communicate visual design, and contribute to our design system.</li> <li>Build prototypes using modern frontend technologies including React, Vue, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.</li> <li>Contribute to the evolution of our design system, reusable UI patterns, and coded component libraries.</li> <li>Leverage AI-native design and development tools to accelerate ideation, generate realistic prototype data, build interactive experiences, and explore multiple design directions.</li> <li>Design and prototype AI-assisted experiences such as conversational interfaces, guided configuration, and intelligent recommendations.</li> <li>Champion thoughtful UX practices and contribute to Ping’s growing design culture.</li> <li>Provide constructive design feedback and mentor other designers through critique and collaboration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>4+ years of experience in UX design, frontend development, or a hybrid design/development role.</li> <li>A strong portfolio demonstrating both thoughtful UX design and interactive coded prototypes.</li> <li>Expert proficiency with modern UX design tools and component-based design systems.</li> <li>Experience building interactive applications using React, Vue, or similar modern frontend frameworks.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, responsive design, and frontend best practices.</li> <li>Experience using code as a prototyping medium—not just for production implementation.</li> <li>Experience working with component-based design systems and frontend component Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. As crypto usage on Fanvue's payment rails keeps growing, so does our exposure to crypto-specific fraud and financial crime. Recent cases have shown gaps in the Fraud team's crypto knowledge, and right now nobody on the team has dedicated crypto fraud or financial crime expertise. This role exists to build that capability from the ground up.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring Fanvue's first Fraud Investigator with dedicated crypto expertise, reporting to Head of Fraud. AI has taken our fraud detection as far as it can on crypto rails, what's missing is in-house subject matter expertise: someone who has used these investigation tools before, can set the strategy, and can train the rest of the team.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Lead on investigating cases of potential fraud or financial crime where crypto rails are involved, including payment fraud, account takeover, and money laundering typologies on crypto on/off-ramps

  • Build out crypto-specific fraud investigation capability within the Fraud team: on-chain tracing methods, tooling, and documented process for crypto-related cases

  • Train the wider Fraud team on crypto fraud red flags and typologies, so risk indicators get caught earlier in standard triage, not just by you

  • Design how Fanvue prevents and detects crypto-related fraud and financial crime as the function matures

  • Work directly with vendors to get the most out of crypto investigation tooling and data

  • Support fraud and financial crime investigations where crypto isn't involved, as part of the wider Fraud team's caseload

  • Lead on escalations to law enforcement where relevant

  • Feed your expertise into loss prevention strategy across Fraud, product, and payments

👀 Who You Are

  • 3+ years investigating fraud and/or financial crime with specific crypto/blockchain exposure, from an exchange, blockchain analytics firm, bank crypto desk, or law enforcement crypto unit

  • A process creator and improver: you've played a role in designing or improving investigation techniques, not just following them

  • Comfortable being the subject matter expert. As our first crypto-focused Fraud hire, you'll build the wider team's knowledge while acting as the go-to for other parts of the business (payments, payouts, product) wherever crypto risk shows up

  • Familiar with crypto investigation tooling (e.g. Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, etc.) and know how to get the most from it in a fraud prevention context

  • High ownership: excited by a large, expanding remit, and not afraid to break new ground without an existing playbook

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build a function from scratch rather than inherit one

  • You're energised by being the go-to expert and enjoy teaching others what you know

  • You like combining hands-on casework with process and systems design

  • You're comfortable working across functions, Fraud, product, payments, to get crypto risk taken seriously

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You need an established playbook, team, or tooling already in place before you can be effective

  • You'd rather stay purely hands-on and not upskill others

  • You're not comfortable being the sole specialist accountable for a new risk area

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • A genuine greenfield opportunity: build Fanvue's first in-house crypto fraud capability from scratch

  • Direct exposure across Fraud, Payments, and Product as crypto usage grows

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on, it's core to our product and how we work

  • Remote-friendly across UK/Europe

  • High annual leave flexibility

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

This role reports to the VP Marketing

Brief overview
This role owns the strategic direction and execution of Skin Analytics' B2B marketing function. Responsible for demand generation, B2B brand positioning, go-to-market strategy, and marketing performance, and be directly accountable for marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue growth across the UK and international markets. The role will lead a small, specialist marketing team, and requires someone who can operate at both a strategic and delivery level, with accountability for commercial outcomes.

Responsibilities

Operations and Team Leadership

  • Own the marketing request and prioritisation process. Manage incoming commercial and product requests against OKRs and team capacity, to deliver commercial priorities matched to team capacity.

  • Manage the day-to-day relationships with external agencies: digital media agency, and design agency, holding them to agreed KPIs and deliverables.

  • Line manage the B2B marketing team. Set clear objectives, maintain output standards, support development, and build a culture of commercial accountability and continuous improvement.

Go-To-Market and International Expansion

  • Continue to support the expansion of UK and Ireland business working in close partnership with commercial leads. Adapt positioning, channel mix, and account marketing strategy to the wider UK health system, procurement culture for NHS and other health partners.

  • Develop, operationalise and own the marketing playbook for international expansion markets, working in close partnership with commercial leads and drawing on best practice from established markets. Adapt positioning, channel mix, and campaign strategy to the specific healthcare system, procurement culture, and regulatory context of each geography.

  • Design and execute the account-based marketing strategy for UK and international markets. Define target account selection criteria and build account tiering in partnership with commercial leadership. Develop account and tier-specific programmes that drive engagement across the buying group and accelerate pipeline within priority accounts.

  • Own ABM programme infrastructure: account list management, personalised content and campaign deployment by account tier, and coordination with commercial teams to align marketing activity to active pipeline opportunities.

  • Own the go-to-market process for new market entries: market readiness assessment, localisation strategy, campaign planning, and commercial team enablement.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Own the HubSpot platform: portal configuration, data integrity, lead scoring, lifecycle stage management, and integration with commercial systems. Configure HubSpot for account-based measurement, including target account lists, company-level engagement scoring, ABM deal influence reporting, and buying group coverage tracking.

  • Design, build, and maintain the attribution model that connects marketing activity to pipeline and revenue. Own the marketing reporting infrastructure, dashboards, campaign tracking, and spend management

  • Building and maintaining AI-assisted content and reporting infrastructure. Evaluate and implement automated and agentic marketing technology that replaces manual work, eg. digital reporting, budget spend management, content library and automated ABM.

  • Manage the marketing technology stack, identify and implement tools that increase team output without proportional headcount growth.

Brand and Content

  • Own the timeline and workstream for the evolving brand integration, ensuring consistent brand expression is rolled out across all content, channels, and markets.

  • Maintain brand and content standards across the all touchpoints, ensuring all output is on-brand, on-message, and aligned to the messaging framework set by the Senior PMM.

Accountable for

  • Target account engagement and account penetration: percentage of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts showing active, tracked engagement with marketing programmes, and coverage of account list with meaningful touch points

  • Pipeline influence: open and closed pipeline within target accounts where marketing has been a contributing touchpoint

  • HubSpot data integrity and pipeline attribution accuracy: a reliable, current source of truth for account-level marketing performance

  • Marketing request SLA: commercial teams receive responses and outputs within agreed timeframes

  • Automation adoption: measurable reduction in manual marketing production tasks, with clear before/after reporting

  • Agency performance: external partners delivering to agreed KPIs and commercial outcomes

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing account-based marketing strategies in a B2B environment, including account selection, tiering methodology, and programme development across named and clustered accounts. Evidence that ABM activity directly influenced pipeline and accelerated deal progression.

  • Hands-on HubSpot platform experience (or similar platform) at an ownership level: data management, lead scoring configuration, lifecycle stage design, and CRM integration with commercial systems. Plus campaign infrastructure, landing page and email automation, smart content, and audience segmentation across the full demand generation funnel.

  • Proven ability to design and execute go-to-market playbooks for new geographies: market entry strategy, localisation, and adapting positioning and channel mix across different market contexts.

  • Experience building and maintaining HubSpot reporting dashboards for leadership: marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and spend efficiency.

  • Track record of tying marketing spend to pipeline and revenue outcomes, with a systematic, data-driven approach to attribution and budget accountability.

  • Ability to build lean, efficient marketing operations: attribution modelling,
    budget management, and systematic use of technology (including Hubspot
    and AI-assisted tooling) to drive efficiency.

  • Credible at Board and exec level: able to represent marketing as a commercial function, present performance data clearly, and influence cross-functional strategy discussions.
